name: Move heavy things
summary: Trade force for distance: pulleys, levers, winches and jacks let one person move what four couldn’t. Pallet jacks sit ignored in every warehouse and roll a tonne or more across a flat floor. Boat trailer and ATV winches hide at marinas and farm stores, and a car wiper or drill motor can drive a homemade winch.

parts.why: Hand and electric winches from trailers, ATVs and trucks
Strong cable for winches and anchors
Ropes and straps for pulling and lashing
Pulleys for a block and tackle
Bottle jacks and cylinders lift tonnes a little at a time
Worm gearboxes hold a load when the motor stops

tips: A block and tackle with four rope sections between the pulleys cuts the pull to about a quarter.
Never stand in line with a loaded rope or cable. If it breaks, it whips back.
Pipe rollers and a long steel bar move engines and machines with no power at all.
Get help, lift with your legs, and never put hands or feet under a raised load.
